title: DarGlobal company overview
text: DarGlobal describes itself as a London-listed international luxury real estate developer. Its portfolio includes residential towers, branded residences, villas, hospitality projects, and mixed-use communities in the Gulf region, Europe, and other international markets. Its website presents projects in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the Maldives. The company highlights partnerships with international hospitality, fashion, automotive, and lifestyle brands. Project announcements and marketing materials do not independently establish current availability, unit prices, completion status, rental yields, or investment returns. Verify time-sensitive details on the linked official project page.

title: DarGlobal official project catalogue
text: DarGlobal's official project catalogue lists residential and hospitality developments across several markets. Names displayed on the catalogue include Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates, The Astera with interiors by Aston Martin, DG1, Da Vinci Tower with interiors by Pagani, Urban Oasis by Missoni, W Residences, The Pagani Penthouse, Tierra Viva inspired by Automobili Lamborghini, Painite Villas, Marea with interiors by Missoni, Les Vagues by Elie Saab, Trump International Qatar at Simaisma, AIDA in Oman, Trump Cliff Villas, Trump Golf Villas, Azure Oceanfront Villas with interiors by FENDI Casa, Marriott Residences AIDA, Trump Tower Jeddah, Rayana and Trump-branded residences in Wadi Safar, Amaya in Jeddah, Padel Living Residences, Neptune with interiors by Mouawad, and Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives. This catalogue is a project-name and location index, not proof that every project is currently available for purchase.

title: Trump International Golf Club, Wadi Safar, Riyadh
text: DarGlobal's announcement dated 11 January 2026 describes Trump International Golf Club, Wadi Safar, in Diriyah near Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The announced site covers approximately 2.6 million square metres within the Wadi Safar masterplan being developed by Diriyah Company. The planned gated community is described as including a Trump-branded championship golf course, a luxury Trump hotel, and premium residences overlooking wadis and golf vistas. This is an announcement about a planned development; it does not confirm current home availability, individual prices, handover dates, or investment returns.

title: Trump Tower Jeddah launch announcement
text: DarGlobal announced Trump Tower Jeddah on 15 December 2024 in partnership with The Trump Organization. The announcement describes a planned 47-floor residential tower on Jeddah's Corniche and gives a project value of SAR 2 billion. It also describes the Trump Club as a planned members-only social club with curated events, dining, and member experiences. These details are from the launch announcement and should not be interpreted as independently verified current construction status, available units, prices, or completion dates.

title: DarGlobal partnership with Wasalt for Trump Tower Jeddah
text: In an announcement dated 16 April 2025, DarGlobal said it had partnered with Wasalt, a Saudi Arabian digital real estate platform, to advertise Trump Tower Jeddah. The announcement says the collaboration was intended to make the development accessible to a wider local audience of investors and property seekers through Wasalt's platform and mobile app. It describes Wasalt as a platform offering property search tools and connections with brokers and residential projects. This is DarGlobal's account of the partnership; the page does not provide a verified current inventory, asking prices, or availability.

title: DarGlobal and The Trump Organization portfolio
text: DarGlobal's official partner page describes a portfolio of collaborations with The Trump Organization across Dubai, Jeddah, and Muscat. Named projects include The Trump Penthouses Dubai, Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, Trump Tower Jeddah, Trump Cliff Villas in Muscat, Trump International Hotel in Muscat, and Trump Golf Villas in Muscat. The page describes AIDA in Oman as a mixed-use development with a hotel, golf villas, and cliff villas. It mentions a 140-key, five-star Trump International Oman hotel complex valued at USD 500 million and says the hotel is scheduled to open in December 2028, with the first phase of AIDA expected to complete in 2027. Treat these as published plans and verify the latest status on official project announcements.

title: AIDA mixed-use development in Muscat, Oman
text: DarGlobal's AIDA project page presents a premium mixed-use development in Muscat, Oman, located on elevated coastal terrain. The wider AIDA portfolio includes villas and branded residences and is associated with golf and hospitality amenities. The official catalogue names Fairway Villas, Azure Oceanfront Villas with interiors by FENDI Casa, Amour Sans Detour, The Great Escape, Coastal Investment Villas, Sunrise Haven, and Marriott Residences AIDA among the offerings associated with the AIDA destination. Individual product specifications, current prices, availability, completion dates, and ownership terms should be checked against the latest official listing or sales materials.

title: Marea, interiors by Missoni, southern Spain
text: DarGlobal and Missoni announced Marea, interiors by Missoni, a residential development in southern Spain near the Finca Cortesin hotel and golf club, with access to the wider Marbella and coastal area. The announcement describes a development of approximately 18,500 square metres with two-, three-, and four-bedroom apartments. Planned amenities described in the announcement include security services, a gym, an infinity pool, a tennis court, and children's play areas. The announcement is not a current inventory or price list.

title: DarGlobal project locations and property types
text: The DarGlobal project catalogue spans multiple locations and property types. Dubai listings include branded towers and residences such as Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, DG1, Da Vinci Tower, Urban Oasis, W Residences, and The Pagani Penthouse. Other UAE projects include D-Villas at Jumeirah Golf Estates and The Astera on Al Marjan Island. Spain listings include Tierra Viva and Painite Villas near Benahavís and Marea near Cortesin. Qatar listings include Les Vagues by Elie Saab and Trump International Qatar at Simaisma. Oman listings include AIDA and several villa and hospitality products. Saudi Arabia listings include Trump Tower Jeddah, Amaya, and developments in Wadi Safar. The Maldives listing is Trump International Hotel & Resort Maldives. The catalogue does not guarantee that all projects are open for sale.

title: DarGlobal press releases and company announcements
text: DarGlobal's official press page publishes company and project announcements, including construction contract awards, project launches, partnerships, sales launches, and financial updates. Examples displayed on the page include announcements about Trump International Hotel & Tower Dubai, Azure Oceanfront Villas with FENDI Casa in Oman, Rayana community infrastructure in Wadi Safar, Trump Villas Simaisma in Qatar, and interim financial results. News pages are time-sensitive: consult the individual dated announcement for the exact date, stated milestone, project location, and whether a detail is a plan, launch, contract award, or completed milestone.

title: Trump International Qatar at Simaisma
text: DarGlobal's official project catalogue lists Trump International Qatar at Simaisma, Qatar, and associated Trump Villas. A DarGlobal press announcement in October 2026 says sales for Trump Villas within Trump International Golf Club Simaisma opened on 1 October 2026. The project is associated with a golf-club concept and a broader coastal masterplan. The catalogue and announcement do not establish an individual villa's current availability, asking price, payment plan, or expected investment return; those require a current official listing or direct confirmation from the sales team.

title: The Astera, interiors by Aston Martin
text: The Astera, interiors by Aston Martin appears in DarGlobal's official project catalogue and is located on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates. The development is presented as a branded residential project associated with Aston Martin interior design. DarGlobal's published project materials have included the project among its UAE developments. This record is a high-level catalogue summary only; exact unit mix, prices, completion status, service charges, and availability must be verified from current official materials.

title: Urban Oasis by Missoni, Dubai
text: Urban Oasis by Missoni is listed in DarGlobal's official project catalogue as a Dubai development. Company materials describe the project as waterfront living with luxury apartments, penthouses, private elevator access for penthouses, premium amenities, and city and canal views. A historical company presentation reported the project as completed; because project status and available resale inventory can change, users should verify current details through the official project or sales channels. This record does not provide current prices or investment projections.

title: Da Vinci Tower, interiors by Pagani, Dubai
text: Da Vinci Tower, interiors by Pagani is listed in DarGlobal's Dubai portfolio as a branded residential tower associated with Pagani design. A historical DarGlobal presentation described a project of 85 units and noted a planned completion milestone in 2025. That information is historical and may not reflect the current status. Verify completion, resale inventory, prices, fees, and unit specifications using current official information before making a property decision.

title: Wasalt terms of use and platform ownership
text: Wasalt's terms of use identify Wasalt Real Estate Services Company as a real estate broker for residential and commercial properties in Saudi Arabia and internationally. The terms cover the Wasalt website, mobile application, and social media pages. Wasalt states that the platform enables owners, developers, agents, and brokers to advertise and market properties. Its terms say site materials, including listings, text, images, and other content, are protected and generally may not be copied, extracted, republished, or used for separate commercial purposes unless expressly permitted. This project knowledge base therefore does not reproduce individual Wasalt listing descriptions.

title: Wasalt intellectual property and data-use restrictions
text: Wasalt's published terms state that website content is owned by Wasalt or the relevant rights holders and restrict copying, extracting, modifying, redistributing, republishing, or using materials for a separate private commercial purpose except where authorized. The terms also prohibit circumventing site policies and collecting information about other users for private purposes. A public webpage is not automatically permission to scrape and republish its contents. For a production data ingestion project, obtain permission or use a licensed feed or API if available. This record summarizes the platform's published terms rather than copying property advertisements.

title: Wasalt privacy policy and service overview
text: Wasalt's privacy policy says it applies to Wasalt Web and the Wasalt app, which provide real estate listing services, as well as the Wasalt Business app for property management services. The policy describes categories of information that may be processed to operate the service, including information provided by users, business-account information, device and activity data, location data, and information from third parties. This is a summary of Wasalt's published privacy policy, not a source of individual property listings. Avoid collecting or exposing personal data from listings or users.

title: Wasalt property listing and verification disclaimer
text: Wasalt's terms explain that property owners, developers, agents, or brokers advertise properties through the platform. Wasalt says it attempts to verify listing details but does not guarantee the correctness, accuracy, or completeness of every advertisement, and users are responsible for checking and confirming details. The terms also advise users to seek appropriate advisors before making a transaction. A chatbot should therefore distinguish advertised claims from verified facts and should not assert that a listing is available, correctly priced, legally clear, or suitable as an investment without current confirmation.

title: Wasalt contact and property inquiry flow
text: Wasalt's terms state that when a user inquires about a property, the user's inquiry details may be sent directly to the agent, broker, owner, or developer marketing that property. The platform is a marketplace and broker service rather than the owner of every listed property. Users should verify the identity of the listing advertiser, the property's current availability, price, transaction terms, and applicable fees directly with the relevant party. This document does not contain current listing inventory or contact details.

title: Wasalt and DarGlobal: Trump Tower Jeddah partnership context
text: DarGlobal's 16 April 2025 announcement says Trump Tower Jeddah would be advertised on Wasalt's platform and mobile app through a partnership between the developer and the Saudi digital real estate platform. The announcement positions the partnership as a way to reach more property seekers and investors in Saudi Arabia. This source is published by DarGlobal, not Wasalt. It confirms the announced partnership context but does not prove the listing is currently live or that any particular unit remains available.

title: Property research safety: prices, availability and returns
text: For property questions, distinguish general company and project information from current transaction data. Neither a project catalogue nor a historic press release confirms a current asking price, available inventory, reservation status, completion date, service charge, financing condition, ownership eligibility, or rental yield. Wasalt's terms place responsibility on users to verify advertised information. The chatbot should say when a current official source was not found, cite the source pages it used, and recommend direct verification with the developer or listing agent rather than inventing numbers or guaranteeing returns.
